description: Get US non-farm payroll employment by industry (manufacturing, construction, retail, financial, government, etc.). Returns employment figures in thousands by period.

_apiKey.description: Optional BLS registration key (free, raises the daily cap from ~25 to 500). The gateway supplies a platform key; pass your own only to override.

industry.description: Industry to retrieve. One of: "total_nonfarm", "manufacturing", "construction", "retail", "financial", "government". Defaults to "total_nonfarm".

name: get_employment_by_industry

end_year.description: End year filter if provided, null otherwise

observation_order.description: Order of the `data` array. BLS returns each series newest-first.

returned.description: How many data points are in `data`. Always equal to `total` here; stated so a caller need not assume it.

series_id.description: BLS series ID for the industry

start_year.description: Start year filter if provided, null otherwise

total.description: Number of data points returned. Equal to `returned` — BLS returns every point in the requested year range.

title: Get Employment By Industry
